title: Open-Turn Trace Formula Audit
architecture_upgrade: Derives compact trace-moment formulas for the first six powers of the direct and paired open-turn operators, showing split at p=4 and equality at p=5.
theorem: The first six trace moments certify distinct closed-walk structure beyond raw transition counts.
honesty_boundary: These are closed formulas for the first six moments, derived by exact enumeration and factorization. A general p-formula remains future work.
